author: Bobby Grayson
description: Runner reads directives from the whole leading comment block, not only line 1 (translate/expect/warn/lean can each be on their own line). check.sh section '== translator fixtures' runs it after '== translate'. Lean check uses lake env lean on a copy under System.tmp_dir/leanactors-fixtures, so the library must be built first; check.sh runs fixtures before lake build, which is fine when .lake is populated but a cold clone should run lake build once first (or move the section after == prove).
title: Integrator: run elixir/test/regen_expected.sh after any translator output change (uniform EBehavior, receive-after, raise, auto registration) and review git diff elixir/test/expected; fixtures live in namespace Leanactors.Fixtures.<Camel>
